Backend Engineer

Join our engineering team to build and maintain scalable backend systems serving millions of users. We're looking for an experienced Backend Engineer to develop robust APIs, manage data infrastructure, and contribute to our core platform architecture.

Must-have:
- 3+ years professional experience with Python
- Experience designing and deploying production APIs
- Strong understanding of relational databases (SQL, PostgreSQL, MySQL)
- Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized deployments

Nice-to-have:
- Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure)
- Familiarity with message queues or async task processing
- Understanding of microservices architecture
- Contribution to open-source projects
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines
